The Petitioner in Petition No. 289/MP/2026 has made the following Prayers: (a) Allow the present Petition; (b) Hold and declare that the Petitioner is eligible for extension of Scheduled Commercial Operation Date for its 190 MW Solar Project with connectivity at Gadag-II PS in terms of the Committee’s Report dated 22.04.2026 to the GNA operationalization date or such extended date as may be considered appropriate, in view of the delay in readiness of the transmission system, not attributable to the Petitioner and; (c) Consequently, hold and declare that the Petitioner is eligible for extension of the waiver from payment of ISTS charges in terms of Regulation 13(2)(h)(ii) of the CERC (Sharing of Inter- State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 (as amended), read with the Office Order dated 30.07.2025 issued by this Hon'ble Commission; AND/OR (d) Pass any such further order(s) and direction(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case. 6. Issues raised in Petition No. 168/MP/2026, Petition No. 187/MP/2026, Petition No. 193/MP/2026 and Petition No. 289/MP/2026 are identical. Hence, pleadings related to Petition No. 168/MP/2026 are captured, leading to analysis and decision in a combined manner. Submissions of the Petitioner in Petition No. 168/MP/2026: 7. The Petitioner has mainly submitted as under: (a) On 01.06.2023, Tata Steel Limited (hereinafter referred to as ‘TSL’) issued a Letter of Award (LoA) to the Petitioner for procurement of power from 965.8 MW wind-solar hybrid power project on a long-term basis. The Petitioner has formed a subsidiary, namely TP Vardhaman Surya Limited (TPVSL), to set up 965.8 MW Wind & Solar Hybrid Projects under the Captive route at various locations in India, including the present Project. The 277.2 MW wind capacity is being set up by TPVSL for supply of power to TSL as a captive user, utilising 288 MW connectivity. (b) On 07.09.2023, the Petitioner applied for Connectivity, under the ‘Land BG Route ’ for a quantum of 288 MW at Koppal-II PS in Koppal, Karnataka. The SCOD indicated at the time of making the application was 01.06.2025. Order in Petition No. 168/MP/2026, 187/MP/2026, 193/MP/2026 and 289/MP/2026 Page 5
